name: Interarch Building Solutions Ltd
title: Interarch Building Solutions Ltd - 544232 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Capacity-constrained PEB maker: FY26 revenue Rs 1,898 cr (+31%) with full utilisation, order book Rs 1,700 cr, and five plants adding ~20,000 tons by Aug, but EBITDA margin flat at 9.3% and operating cash flow turned negative.

utilisation.quote: The capacities that we have are more or less fully utilized.

capex.quote: we have started two new plants, one in Andhra Pradesh (To be read as “we started the construction of two new plants”)

triggers.label: Gujarat PEB plant commercial production July
triggers.quote: Trial production Wil start in June, and commercial production will start by July.

triggers.label: Capacity ~180,000 t/yr; Q4 volume 41,000 t
triggers.quote: we are currently doing about 40,000 tons a quarter and it will gradually move up.

triggers.label: Operating cash flow negative in FY26
triggers.quote: your cash flow from operations have turned negative for this particular year.

triggers.label: EBITDA margin flat at 9.3%
triggers.quote: EBITDA margin steady at 9.3% in spite of these provisions

triggers.label: FY27 revenue Rs 2,150-2,200 cr
triggers.quote: I think we should be somewhere between Rs. 2,150 crores to Rs. 2,200 crores

guidance.quote: I think we should be somewhere between Rs. 2,150 crores to Rs. 2,200 crores
And Rs. 2,500 crores for 27-28 as projected some years ago.
I think it is a very good margin if we can sustain it

prior_guidance_check.metric: FY26 revenue (Rs 1,720 cr then raised to 1,850 cr)
prior_guidance_check.quote: we have managed to achieve Rs. 1,900-1,898 crores
We are very much on track, except that we lost that one month in the beginning.
I think we are projected 15%, but I think we should be somewhere between Rs. 2,150 crores to Rs. 2,200 crores

red_flags.label: Negative operating cash flow with rising debtors
red_flags.quote: your cash flow from operations have turned negative for this particular year.

red_flags.label: Gujarat plant delayed again
red_flags.quote: we lost about a month, month and a half.

red_flags.label: Order book flat-to-up only 3% YoY; growth capped by capacity
red_flags.quote: So, if my average order book is already nine months, I can't take more orders

evasions.quote: Right now, a lot of the large projects get divided between two or three players
But let us sce how much heavy structure we can add and change our guidance.
